hypothesis: A warm cache hit under C1 co-completes with the preceding sent request, leaving a near-zero adjacent full-response gap even when the first response ID is uninformative.
attacker_inputs: own send order, request IDs, own complete client receive times; no proxy/backend times, cached-token details, or secret warm label
primary_observer: For adjacent complete client receive times in send order, if the smallest absolute gap exceeds 10 ms predict warm send position 1; otherwise predict the position immediately after the smallest absolute gap.
secondary_observers: R1 and logistic T2/RT trained on prior C1 primary only, C=1 with StandardScaler
decision_rule: A prospective 32-positive run with at least 24 correct primary predictions and cache-hit integrity on all positives merits a new research direction; otherwise treat historical 32/32 as unexplained or unstable. Stop after this run and its four controls.
limitation: The old C1 observer and 10 ms threshold were selected after exploring old data; the new seed and backend start are the first frozen confirmation.
